{
  "summary": "Valve FV-101 is raising a discrepancy alarm because its position (ZT-101 at 57.0 %) does not follow the command (38.8), with an active gap of 18.2. The most likely cause is that fibre and lint have jammed the valve trim, a seized stem, a loss of instrument air, a failed positioner, or a position transmitter fault.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "Loss of instrument air to the actuator, or a failed positioner.",
    "Fibre and lint jamming the valve trim, or a seized stem.",
    "Position transmitter fault (the valve moves but ZT-101 does not)."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Check the instrument air pressure at the actuator and the positioner output.",
    "Look at the valve stem and position indicator locally and compare them with ZT-101 on the HMI.",
    "Check whether the forward flow FIT-102 changes when the command changes."
  ],
  "handover": "Investigated alarm FV-101 position discrepancy raised at 2026-10-05 10:02 with valve position at 57.0 % and command at 38.8. Verified checks according to SOP-07 and prepared for valve maintenance or manual control if confirmed stuck.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-07 7.3",
    "SOP-07 7.4",
    "SOP-07 7.2"
  ]
}
